* '''Playtest''' ([[Commander Vanden Willard (V) (Playtest)]], 1 August 2019): Playtest image, published before the set's official release (2 August 2019) and replaced before it. Players Committee card image, 1 August 2019: [[:File:V11-L-commandervandenwillard-20190801.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e26d0f1/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Light/large/commandervandenwillard.gif Holotable commit e26d0f1 “Images part 1”]), no mark. Text: “Alderaanian. Once per game, may place your just lost Alderaanian in Used Pile. Once per turn, if Stolen Data Tapes 'delivered,' a system 'liberated,' or Stardust on your spy, may place a card from hand on Used Pile to draw top card of Reserve Deck.”
* '''Original''' ([[Commander Vanden Willard (V)]], 2 August 2019): Original: the image at the set's official release (2 August 2019). Players Committee card image, 2 August 2019: [[:File:V11-L-commandervandenwillard-20190802.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/d24ffc3/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Light/large/commandervandenwillard.gif Holotable commit d24ffc3 “Flipped sites”]), no mark. Text: “Alderaanian. Once per game, may place your just lost Alderaanian in Used Pile. Once per turn, if Stolen Data Tapes 'delivered,' a system 'liberated,' or Stardust on your spy, may place a card from hand on Used Pile to draw top card of Reserve Deck.” '''What changed:''' re-rendered on release day with sharper graphics; the lore now prints “Leader” and “spy” in bold (characteristics); same words.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page, 29 March 2023): Players Committee card image, 29 March 2023: [[:File:V11-L-commandervandenwillard.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/168657a/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Light/hires/commandervandenwillard.png Holotable commit 168657a “Set 11 Remastered”]), no mark. Text: “Alderaanian. Once per game, may place your just lost Alderaanian in Used Pile. Once per turn, if Stolen Data Tapes 'delivered,' a system 'liberated,' or Stardust on your spy, may place a card from hand on Used Pile to draw top card of Reserve Deck.” '''What changed:''' Set 11 remaster: same words (the quotation marks around 'delivered,' and 'liberated,' are now curly); re-rendered at high resolution.
